summary.name: LuckyPays Casino
summary.one_liner: LuckyPays is an online casino and sportsbook aimed at UK players, offering slots, live casino, virtual sports and cryptocurrency deposits under an Anjouan Gaming (Comoros / AOFA) licence.
use_cases: Playing online slots and live dealer tables in the UK
Claiming a casino welcome bonus and free spins
Betting on football, horse racing and other sports from one account
Installing a casino app on Android or iOS
Setting deposit or session limits for responsible gambling
summary.what_it_does: The site offers a casino library the page says exceeds 8,000 games, including slots, roulette, blackjack, live casino, baccarat, bingo, keno, crash games and poker, supplied by providers such as Pragmatic Play, Play'n GO, Hacksaw Gaming and PG Soft. It accepts fiat cards, bank transfer and many cryptocurrencies, with a listed minimum deposit of £10. A sportsbook sits in the same account and covers football, horse racing, tennis, rugby, cricket, boxing/MMA and eSports. Account features include a welcome bonus (100% match up to £650 plus 77 free spins, with wagering requirements), reload bonuses, cashback and a VIP programme. Responsible gambling tools such as deposit, loss and session limits and self-exclusion are described, along with live chat and email support.
notable: Accepts many cryptocurrencies (BTC, ETH, LTC, XRP, USDT, SOL, DOGE and others) alongside cards and bank transfer
Over 8,000 games from multiple providers, with demo mode for most titles
Android APK sold direct from site (not on Google Play); iOS app via App Store
Sportsbook and casino share one account balance
caveats: Real-money gambling only for players aged 18 or over; identity and payment-method verification is required before first withdrawal
Bonus wagering requirements, maximum bet limits and 30-day expiry apply; cashback and VIP terms vary by promotion
Daily, weekly and monthly withdrawal limits of £3,350, £8,400 and £16,800 apply
Support is in English only and there is no phone line
